# fixture

### Module manifest (mandatory)

Every module under `src/modules/<name>/` has this shape. The structure audit reads this table: it checks required entries and forbids anything not listed.

| Entry | Required | Responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| `schema/db.ts` | when the module owns tables | Drizzle tables and relations. Server-only. Modules that only read core tables (`home`, `settings`, `users`) have none. |
| `schema/validation.ts` | yes | Zod schemas (entity, create, update, list query, AI I/O) and derived types. Client-safe: no Drizzle imports. |
| `schema/index.ts` | when `schema/db.ts` exists | Re-exports both; marked `server-only` when it exports `db.ts` (client code imports `schema/validation` directly). |
| `repo.ts` | when the module owns tables | All SQL. May use `core/db`, `core/links` edge helpers, `core/search`. No business rules. |
| `service.ts` | yes | Business rules, invariants, transactions, explicit orchestration of other modules through their `index.ts`, audit writes, job enqueueing. Actor-aware: every function takes `ctx`. |
| `api.ts` | yes | `defineHandler` implementations. |
| `jobs.ts` | if the module owns jobs | Job handlers registered in `core/jobs/registry.ts`. |
| `ai/` | if the module owns capabilities | `capabilities.ts` and `prompts/<name>.v<N>.ts`. |
| `ui/` | yes | Components, `queries.ts` (TanStack hooks), `index.ts` (components other modules may reuse). |
| `tests/` | yes | Scenario tests named by requirement ID (see `08-testing-strategy.md`). |
| `index.ts` | yes | Public surface: service functions and types for other modules, plus `server`. |
| `manifest.ts` | yes | Client-safe declaration (`id`, optional `nav` entry). `index.ts` additionally exports `server: ServerManifest` (home sections, job kinds). `core/modules` composes both; nothing else lists modules. |


## Repository layout

Target layout for v1. `docs/STATUS.md` (generated by `pnpm audit:docs --status`) lists which of the named files exist today; the structure audit allows exactly the top-level entries shown here.

```
.
├── AGENTS.md  CLAUDE.md  README.md  SECURITY.md  LICENSE  NOTICE
├── .github/                       ci.yml, issue and pull request templates
├── docs/                          specs, ADRs, history/ (hand-offs and reviews), STATUS.md
├── drizzle/                       generated + custom SQL migrations, meta, custom-objects.json (committed)
├── e2e/                           Playwright scenarios, global-setup.ts, fixtures/
├── scripts/                       audit/, db/, backup/ (tsx), audit/tests/ (fixtures that violate rules)
├── tests/                         setup/ (test database), fixtures/ (sample values)
├── src/
│   ├── instrumentation.ts         starts jobs runner + scheduler (nodejs runtime, once)
│   ├── app/
│   │   ├── (auth)/login, setup, recovery
│   │   ├── (app)/home tasks notes committees kpis initiatives meetings people admin
│   │   └── api/v1/<resource>/route.ts
│   ├── core/
│   │   ├── config/                env.ts, settings.ts (typed registry), principal.ts
│   │   ├── db/                    client.ts, migrate.ts, tx.ts, schema.ts (re-exports), introspect.ts, query-log.ts
│   │   ├── auth/                  session.ts, password.ts, guards.ts, rate-limit.ts, setup.ts
│   │   ├── http/                  handler.ts, errors.ts, pagination.ts, idempotency.ts, client.ts, openapi.ts
│   │   ├── jobs/                  runner.ts, queue.ts, scheduler.ts, registry.ts, types.ts
│   │   ├── ai/                    client.ts, provider.ts, anthropic.ts, fake.ts, budget.ts, models.ts, capabilities.ts
│   │   ├── i18n/                  request.ts, locales.ts, messages/en.json, messages/ar.json
│   │   ├── links/                 links service, relation registry, edges view helpers, context query
│   │   ├── files/                 storage.ts (interface + local), upload.ts, hashing.ts, purge.ts
│   │   ├── backup/                dump.ts, restore.ts, manifest.ts, maintenance.ts
│   │   ├── search/                search_text helpers, normalization
│   │   └── audit/                 audit_log writer
│   ├── modules/
│   │   ├── tasks/ notes/ committees/ kpis/ initiatives/ meetings/ people/ users/ settings/ home/
│   └── ui/
│       ├── primitives/  entity/  links/  charts/  layout/  markdown/  tokens.css
├── tools/                         eslint/ (custom rules), capture scripts, Docker Playwright config
├── .dependency-cruiser.cjs        layering rules on the real import graph
├── docker-compose.yml  docker-compose.dev.yml  docker-compose.test.yml  Dockerfile  .dockerignore
├── .env.example  .env.test.example  .gitignore  .prettierrc.json  .prettierignore
├── openapi.json                   generated by audit:openapi, committed
└── package.json  pnpm-lock.yaml  tsconfig.json  next.config.ts  drizzle.config.ts  knip.json
    eslint.config.mjs  postcss.config.mjs  vitest.config.ts  playwright.config.ts
```
